title: observability: token-kv metrics + tracing + dashboard improvements and alert tuning
author: Maya Chen
commits: b1f4c9a: add baseline KV cache metrics (hits, misses, eviction_count) and expose via metrics_registry
d9a3e1b: instrument token-level cost/latency tags on request span and emit prometheus labels
e3c2b77: add tracing hooks for KV read/write and cache warming paths
c4b8f0e: add alert tuning for cache-miss spike and token-latency-p95
9f6d2bc: frontend: token cost chart and filtering by model/route
a8b9d11: docs: kv-metrics guide and rollout notes
2e3a7ff: fix: handle null model_id in legacy spans
4f5b6c0: small perf tweak: reduce label cardinality for heavy routes
body: Summary: Add token-KV specific metrics and tracing, new dashboards for token-level cost and latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy incidents while preserving SLO coverage. Motivation: We observed an increase in incidents where KV-cache-related spikes caused disproportionate token latency and cost which was hard to attribute from existing metrics. This PR adds targeted metrics and tracing hooks and ships dashboards and alert rules to make root-cause analysis faster and reduce alert fatigue. What changed: 1) Instrumentation: added KV metrics (kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_misses, kv_cache_evictions, kv_lookup_latency_seconds) exposed via the central metrics_registry; added token-level tags on request spans (route, model_variant, token_bucket) to enable cost/latency breakdowns; added tracing_kv hooks for read/write/warm paths. 2) Dashboards: token_kv_overview shows per-model and per-route KV hit/miss rates, cost per-token heatmap, and correlation panels for KV-miss vs P95 token latency; cost_latency_breakdown provides a token-level waterfall for counting tokens by source (cache/local/model) and estimated cost. 3) Alerts: introduced kv-cache-miss-spike (thresholded on sustained miss-rate increase with sensible cooldown/aggregation to avoid flapping) and token-latency-p95 (route scoped with dynamic thresholds tied to historical baseline). 4) Frontend: small observability console components to filter dashboards by model, route, and time-window; added TokenCostChart component and export to CSV. 5) Docs and rollout: docs/observability/kv-metrics.md describes new metrics and migration notes for private clusters. Testing: unit tests for metrics registry and tagging; integration tests that assert metric emission under synthetic workloads; e2e manifest verified dashboards render in the console and alerts fire on synthetic perturbations. Rollout plan: feature gated via observability.feature_flags.token_kv_metrics; start with internal prod-canary then gradual ramp to 100% over two weeks; migrate alerts in three phases (monitor-only -> notify-once -> full-on-call). Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves existing metrics if feature flag disabled; label cardinality capped and sampled to prevent high-cost metrics. Known limitations: token-level tagging adds cardinality; mitigated by token_bucket sampling and route-only rollouts. Release notes: New observability metrics and dashboards for KV cache and token-level cost/latency. Tuned alerts to reduce noise. No breaking changes for API consumers.
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: please reduce label cardinality for model_variant when model_variant is high-cardinality; suggested bucketing. Author reply (Maya Chen): implemented a model_variant bucketer and added config with default buckets.

Priya Patel: can we add a short retention note for token-level metrics in private deployments? Author reply (Maya Chen): added docs section and config knobs for retention in docs/observability/kv-metrics.md.
Samira Khan: alert thresholds look reasonable; request adding runbook links in alert descriptions. Author reply (Maya Chen): added runbook links to kv_cache_alerts.yaml and alert descriptions.
CI bot: kv-cache-test flaky under heavy load; retried and passed after a single rerun.
QA (E2E): dashboards render but CSV export had timezone issue; fixed in TokenCostChart.tsx (now always uses UTC).
release_notes:
- Added KV cache metrics (kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_misses, kv_cache_evictions, kv_lookup_latency_seconds)
- Added token-level cost/latency dashboards (token_kv_overview, cost_latency_breakdown)
- Tuned alerts for KV-miss spikes and token latency P95 to reduce noise
- Console filters and CSV export for token cost analysis
